brief: A resort-town house in Petoskey: Jacob VanZolenburg's house, as photographed — see the photo for its massing and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: Petoskey's resort-town streets (the town's model) were built 1880-1930, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the VanZolenburg House (Petoskey, 1900): a big green fish-scale-shingled Queen Anne with a gabled dormer, a long wrap porch on turned posts, a window air conditioner, bikes and a grill under a cover on the lawn: a house cut into rental units; chain-link at the side

why.note: a large Victorian divided into apartments
